All dimensions, integers, and endpoint cases are addressed analytically. value.rationale: The source explicitly left its parallel-design rule as finite numerical evidence, even though the dimension of the random subspace directly determines computational work. Proving an unrestricted, sharp resource-allocation law, including incomplete parallel batches and the unique two-core tie, replaces a finite parameter scan by a complete classification with a useful exact scheduling guarantee for the stated local expected-descent metric. This is a motivated missing structural inequality rather than a parameter substitution; the narrow idealized scope and absence of full runtime guarantees are disclosed.
